title: 城堡掌门最后悔的事：当年没留住亚马逊，如今互联网巨头为何崛起？
speaker: Ken Griffin

segments.en: I remember back in 1999, 2000, the metrics
segments.zh: 我记得1999、2000年时，那些指标

segments.en: that we used to value internet companies,
segments.zh: 我们用来给互联网公司估值，

segments.en: and let's be clear, some of these internet companies
segments.zh: 而且要说清楚，其中一些互联网公司

segments.en: had pretty fanciful business models.
segments.zh: 商业模式相当天马行空。

segments.en: But I mean, I just wish I'd kept my Amazon stock
segments.zh: 但我的意思是，我真希望当时留住了亚马逊的权益资产

segments.en: from that moment in time.
segments.zh: 从那个时候起。

segments.en: And the internet, which was the great bubble,
segments.zh: 而互联网，那个巨大的泡沫，

segments.en: could it be more of a part of our daily life today
segments.zh: 它今天能更融入我们的日常生活吗

segments.en: than it is?
segments.zh: 比现在更融入吗？

segments.en: I mean, I've told the story before,
segments.zh: 我的意思是，我以前讲过这个故事，

segments.en: but I was updating my Xbox on my son a few years ago.
segments.zh: 几年前我在给我儿子的Xbox更新。

segments.en: He was 13 at the time, and he looks at me.
segments.zh: 他当时13岁，他看着我说。

segments.en: And he goes, Dad, you lived before the internet existed.
segments.zh: 他说，爸爸，你生活在互联网出现之前。

segments.en: And I said, I was born after the dinosaurs disappeared.
segments.zh: 我说，我出生在恐龙消失之后。

segments.en: But yes, there was life before the internet.
segments.zh: 但没错，互联网出现之前是有生活的。

segments.en: And now it's like an incomprehensible thought
segments.zh: 现在这对20岁的人来说

segments.en: to a 20-year-old.
segments.zh: 是难以理解的想法。

segments.en: So these bubbles, if we're going to use that word,
segments.zh: 所以这些泡沫，如果我们用这个词的话，

segments.en: often coincide with these giant technological transformations.
segments.zh: 常常与这些巨大的技术转型同时发生。

segments.en: The railroads, for example.
segments.zh: 例如铁路。

segments.en: But what's left in the wake of these bubbles,
segments.zh: 但这些泡沫过后留下的，

segments.en: if we want to use that word, is often
segments.zh: 如果我们用这个词的话，往往是

segments.en: game-changing for the world.
segments.zh: 改变世界的。

segments.en: And the companies that are on the other side of that bubble
segments.zh: 而泡沫另一边的公司

segments.en: are the market leaders for decades to come.
segments.zh: 将成为未来几十年的市场领导者。
